Emilia (Product): Heads-up: sales wants a one-pager we can hand pilots summarizing commitments (SLA, billing, support, monitoring). Can we make this super short?
Ty (Eng): Yes. Call out per-model-family qualifiers for latency. Keep fallback promise: auto-route to compatible model variant.
Sofia (SRE): Proposed customer-facing SLOs: 99.9% monthly availability; low-latency family p95 < 150ms (region dependent). Paging rules: page if p99 > 350ms for 5m or error rate >5% for 3m. Canary: 10% for 24h.
Ravi (FinOps): Pilot billing: estimate + 30-day true-up; option: reserved capacity vs burst surcharge (+12%). Include sample invoice line.
Ben (Docs): I'll draft the one-pager and a two-sentence incident blurb customers can reuse. Need final SLA numbers and the exact support ack times.
Clara (Support): Support targets: P1 ack 1h, P2 ack 4h business hours. We will include canned status text: "We routed traffic to a compatible model variant to preserve availability; investigating."
release-bot: Staging note: pilot-commitments-sheet v0.1 deployed at 2025-08-02T16:05:00Z
Emilia (Product): Action items: Ben -> one-pager draft; Sofia -> pin alert rules + runbook link; Ravi -> sample invoice; Ty -> fallback mapping. Please ack here when done.
Ty (Eng): ack, will PR mapping today.
Sofia (SRE): ack, pushing rules and PD mapping.
Ravi (FinOps): ack, sending invoice sample by EOD.
Ben (Docs): ack, publishing draft for review.
Emilia (Product): thanks — aiming to hand this to Sales tomorrow morning.
